summary: TJGC Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing and closing of a best-efforts offering of 15,000,000 ordinary shares at $0.40 per share, for gross proceeds of $6 million. The offering was placed by Eddid Securities USA Inc. on a reasonable best-efforts basis, with a 4% cash fee. Net proceeds of ~$5.44 million will fund AI R&D, market expansion, and working capital. Directors, officers, and 10%+ holders entered 30-day lock-ups. This is a routine capital raise under an effective F-1 registration statement, not a special situation. No watch items.
